segment.source: Mark a pending state of switch.
segment.target: Mark a pending estado de alternância.

segment.source: ToggleSwitch is used for immediate on/off decisions. It supports disabled state, loading state, custom on/off content, icon content, size variants, motion, and wave feedback.
segment.target: ToggleSwitch é usado para immediate em/off decisions. Isso oferece suporte desativado estado, carregando estado, personalizado em/off conteúdo, ícone conteúdo, tamanho variantes, motion, e wave feedback.

segment.source: Switch between two mutually exclusive states with optional text, icons, loading, and size variants.
segment.target: Alternância between dois mutually exclusive states com opcional texto, ícones, carregando, e tamanho variantes.

segment.source: Content element with block display, overflow hidden, border radius, height, padding, transition animations and other switch content area layout and styles
segment.target: Content element com block display, overflow hidden, border radius, height, padding, transition animations e outros switch content area layout e styles

segment.source: Indicator element with absolute positioning, width, height, background color, border radius, shadow, transition animations and other switch handle styles and interactive effects
segment.target: Indicator element com absolute positioning, width, height, background color, border radius, shadow, transition animations e outros switch handle styles e interactive effects

segment.source: Use owner-scoped selectors and ToggleSwitch property selectors to customize the published Semantic Parts.
segment.target: Use owner-scoped selectors e ToggleSwitch property selectors para customize o published Semantic Parts.

segment.source: Root element with min-width, height, line-height, vertical alignment, background color, border, border radius, cursor style, transition animations, user selection and other basic switch container styles
segment.target: Root element com min-width, height, line-height, vertical alignment, background color, border, border radius, cursor style, transition animations, user selection e outros basic switch container styles

segment.source: SizeType controls preset and Custom switch size modes.
segment.target: SizeType controles predefinido e Personalizado alternância tamanho modes.
